context_check.sentence: The domain is elapsed time t ≥ 0 with liters as the output; 300 liters is a plausible positive amount after five minutes, and removing the tank-and-pump context leaves the same calculation 180 + 24×5.
The domain is t ≥ 0 minutes and q(t) counts boxes; 34 is a nonnegative whole-number count, and removing the station context leaves direct substitution into q(6)=4×6+10.

The model applies for elapsed hours t ≥ 0 and counts orders; the inferred slope is 5 orders per hour and gives a plausible total of 50 at hour 8, while removing the dashboard context leaves linear extrapolation from (2,20) and (6,40).
The domain is elapsed time 0 ≤ t ≤ 12 hours and volume in liters; 36 liters remains after 8 hours within that bound, and removing the reservoir context leaves solving 100−8t=36.
